title: Absolem's Base Painting Pack
description: Adds a handful of paintings made by Absolem Jackdaw
body:
### Absolem's Painting Base pack.

This used to be a [resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/painting++-base-painting-pack), made specifically for [Paintings++](https://modrinth.com/mod/paintings++).

This Painting Pack is made with the [Painting Pack Maker](https://github.com/AbsolemJackdaw/PaintingPackMaker/releases). 
We recommend to install [Paintings++](https://modrinth.com/mod/paintings++) to more easily select your paintings when placing them down.  

Since the 1.21 update, the way paintings get registered has changed fundamentally. 
Therefor, this pack is now available as a datapack, ready to be used regardless of the prescence of [Paintings++](https://modrinth.com/mod/paintings++). 

 
### Installation Guide:   


With CurseForge client : no more steps needed.
Manually : make sure you put the datapack in both datapacks folder  in your world save and the resourcepack folder in your installation folder. 

 

Contents : 
> Handcrafted pixel art paintings.  
> Popculture pixelized paintings  
> Scaled down screenshots of minecraft buildings and worlds  

_Notice : all low effort paintings will be replaced over time by handcrafted pixel art to make a truly unique pack._
